in_sanskrit.name: Manpreet
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Man: Person; Preet: Love
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Manpreet एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Manpreet is derived from Sanskrit. The name consists of two words: Man and Preet. Man means person, and Preet means love. The name Manpreet, therefore, signifies a person who is loved by many or someone who loves many.
